faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitleBefore: If you can't find an answer, reach us via the
faq.a1: From the website or mobile app, choose the service you need, set the date and time, and pay online. Once the provider confirms, the service is delivered on time.
faq.a2: Yes. Every provider goes through manual identity and professional credential verification at signup. Verified providers get the "Verified" badge.
faq.a3: All payments are protected by bank-grade SSL encryption via the Epoint payment system. Your card details never touch our servers.
faq.a4: Yes, if you cancel at least 4 hours before the service starts, the payment is fully refunded.
faq.a5: Yes, registration and creating a profile are completely free. A small commission applies only to successfully completed orders.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, store, and protect your personal data

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: At Ellit.az we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our services and how we use it.

collect.title: Data we collect
collect.body: Name, email, phone number, address, payment details, and service usage history. Browser and device info (for anonymous analytics only).

use.title: How we use data
use.body: Fulfilling orders, processing payments, customer support, improving the platform, and complying with legal requirements.

security.title: Security
security.body: Your data is protected with bank-grade SSL encryption. Card details are never stored on our servers — they are processed only via Epoint.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to, modification, or deletion of your data at any time by writing to support@ellit.az.
